notes: agentDispatch.js and routes/connector.js are NOT in the plan's ownership list. They are here because the price has to be quoted off the RESOLVED run - named params, then the size deepinfraSizing actually fits and sends - and that resolution only exists in the renderer, where estimateRunCost already lives. agentLoop holds a ratio LABEL and no pixels, so pricing there would have been a second copy of the arithmetic and would have drifted from MPI-852's tag.

services/agentTools.mjs is read-only on purpose: tests/agent-no-delete.test.cjs pins its export list and its observed METHOD /path set, so touching it is what trips that suite (absorbed MPI-854 map, edit 6).
routes/agent.js is read-only: the pendingConfirm projection that needs the new fields is getHistory() in agentLoop.mjs, not the route.
